blocks.text: Acorn Recovery Living is a sober living program that aims to provide continued support to individuals in early recovery. The program is a part of Cedars at Cobble Hill, which is renowned for providing top-notch addiction treatment services throughout North America. The program follows an integrative healing approach that emphasizes the importance of mind, body, and spirit in recovery, along with community support, family systems, social involvement, and recreation. Clients participate in a structured program that includes group accountability sessions, in-house and community-based 12-Step meetings, meal preparations, and morning check-ins. The extended care program is designed to teach valuable life and social skills within a supportive environment.

blocks.text: Acorn Recovery Living by Cedars is committed to helping individuals achieve their ultimate goal of a successful recovery. Offering long-term support in their South Surrey homes, Cedars’ transitional living program provides a safe and healthy environment for individuals to transition into following their departure from the inpatient treatment centre. The recovery homes provide both men and women the opportunity to rebuild their lives while continuing to receive guidance on recovery management.

centre.name: Acorn Recovery Living
centre.about_html:
Acorn Recovery Living is a sober living program that aims to provide continued support to individuals in early recovery. The program is a part of Cedars at Cobble Hill, which is renowned for providing top-notch addiction treatment services throughout North America. The program follows an integrative healing approach that emphasizes the importance of mind, body, and spirit in recovery, along with community support, family systems, social involvement, and recreation. Clients participate in a structured program that includes group accountability sessions, in-house and community-based 12-Step meetings, meal preparations, and morning check-ins. The extended care program is designed to teach valuable life and social skills within a supportive environment.

Location and Accommodation

Acorn Recovery Living is located in Surrey, the urban community of British Columbia that offers various recreational opportunities within walking distance or a 10-minute drive. The region’s ideal location also provides easy access to Vancouver and the US border. The program offers comfortable, gender-specific accommodations in upscale residential homes that ensure a peaceful and relaxing environment for individuals in recovery.

Staff and Support

Acorn Recovery Living boasts a team of compassionate and knowledgeable staff members who are themselves in recovery. Each staff member serves as a manager and elder in the house community, reflecting the values and teachings of recovery while offering the necessary structure and support throughout the program. All activities take place in group meetings, where residents can interact, learn from one another, and build a strong support system.

Acorn Recovery Living - Center Overview

Acorn Recovery Living by Cedars is committed to helping individuals achieve their ultimate goal of a successful recovery. Offering long-term support in their South Surrey homes, Cedars’ transitional living program provides a safe and healthy environment for individuals to transition into following their departure from the inpatient treatment centre. The research has shown that ongoing care is crucial to achieving and maintaining sobriety; this is something Cedars prioritizes and ensures this type of care is available. The recovery homes provide both men and women the opportunity to rebuild their lives while continuing to receive guidance on recovery management.

At Acorn Recovery Living, Cedars’ staff is devoted to helping individuals gain the skills and confidence needed to maintain their recovery. For some, incorporating structured recovery management strategies is a challenge. Cedars’ Acorn Recovery Living staff provides guidance and support to those who need it the most. Through a comprehensive approach towards treatment, patients are taught essential principles and given the support necessary to achieve their goals of a lasting recovery. With a competent and compassionate team by their side, individuals are guided through the rigors of early recovery to achieve their ultimate goal of a successful and long-term recovery.

Aftercare

Amenities

raw_html:
Acorn Recovery Living is a sober living program that aims to provide continued support to individuals in early recovery. The program is a part of Cedars at Cobble Hill, which is renowned for providing top-notch addiction treatment services throughout North America. The program follows an integrative healing approach that emphasizes the importance of mind, body, and spirit in recovery, along with community support, family systems, social involvement, and recreation. Clients participate in a structured program that includes group accountability sessions, in-house and community-based 12-Step meetings, meal preparations, and morning check-ins. The extended care program is designed to teach valuable life and social skills within a supportive environment.

Location and Accommodation

Acorn Recovery Living is located in Surrey, the urban community of British Columbia that offers various recreational opportunities within walking distance or a 10-minute drive. The region’s ideal location also provides easy access to Vancouver and the US border. The program offers comfortable, gender-specific accommodations in upscale residential homes that ensure a peaceful and relaxing environment for individuals in recovery.

Staff and Support

Acorn Recovery Living boasts a team of compassionate and knowledgeable staff members who are themselves in recovery. Each staff member serves as a manager and elder in the house community, reflecting the values and teachings of recovery while offering the necessary structure and support throughout the program. All activities take place in group meetings, where residents can interact, learn from one another, and build a strong support system.

Acorn Recovery Living - Center Overview

Acorn Recovery Living by Cedars is committed to helping individuals achieve their ultimate goal of a successful recovery. Offering long-term support in their South Surrey homes, Cedars’ transitional living program provides a safe and healthy environment for individuals to transition into following their departure from the inpatient treatment centre. The research has shown that ongoing care is crucial to achieving and maintaining sobriety; this is something Cedars prioritizes and ensures this type of care is available. The recovery homes provide both men and women the opportunity to rebuild their lives while continuing to receive guidance on recovery management.

At Acorn Recovery Living, Cedars’ staff is devoted to helping individuals gain the skills and confidence needed to maintain their recovery. For some, incorporating structured recovery management strategies is a challenge. Cedars’ Acorn Recovery Living staff provides guidance and support to those who need it the most. Through a comprehensive approach towards treatment, patients are taught essential principles and given the support necessary to achieve their goals of a lasting recovery. With a competent and compassionate team by their side, individuals are guided through the rigors of early recovery to achieve their ultimate goal of a successful and long-term recovery.
